checks.name: Spelling Bee requires typed spelling, keeps native Kokoro word playback, and has no speech-scoring controls
entering Spelling Bee cancels inherited capture and cannot score its late spoken whole word
Spelling Bee completes instruction before one word, then native normal / slow / normal replays finish at 1 / 0.5 / 1 rates
early manual replay claims startup playback, and turning instructions off still plays the word once
native: exact isolated sound waits for confirmation and duplicate final/confirm events score once
shared: exact isolated sound waits for confirmation and duplicate final/confirm events score once
Missing Letter retries without consuming an attempt and confirms the replacement transcript in mobile and desktop layouts
mismatched whole-word speech asks for confirmation before normal incorrect feedback
matching whole-word speech retains immediate grading in Word Scramble
editing the same word’s hidden letter invalidates pending confirmation and uses the new target
returning to answer buttons discards pending speech without a wrong response
speech errors and silence expose retry and button fallback without costing an attempt
missing_letter: picture on/off and persisted full/compact anchors keep visible and accessible answer text hidden until explicit reveal
word_scramble: picture on/off and persisted full/compact anchors keep visible and accessible answer text hidden until explicit reveal
missing_letter: production portable serialization and fresh reopen preserve picture support, hide the answer, and keep correct voice behavior
word_scramble: production portable serialization and fresh reopen preserve picture support, hide the answer, and keep correct voice behavior
starting voice capture stops isolation sequence and prevents later option clips
rapid isolation instruction repeats use one managed audio channel
late isolation instruction TTS cannot interrupt capture and keeps strict Kokoro English options
unmount cancels isolation sequence without delayed option playback

Native playback uses existing local Kokoro word-bank clips and standard instruction/phoneme bank clips. No live Kokoro synthesis, cloud calls, physical microphone, or pronunciation judgment was performed.
